summary: Promotional and documentary overview of the Kakrapar Atomic Power Station Unit-4 (KAPP-4) project, detailing its construction scale, statistical highlights, and initial fuel loading ceremony attended by NPCIL chairman Shri Bhuwan Chandra Pathak.

spans.shows: NPCIL logo animation with text against a gradient background
spans.onscreen_text: NPCIL Another Feather In It's Cap

spans.shows: Aerial pan of Kakrapar Atomic Power Station site with reactor buildings and surrounding greenery
spans.onscreen_text: Kakrapar Atomic Power Station KAPP-3&4 (2 x 700 MW, PHWR)

spans.shows: Close-up aerial view of Kakrapar site buildings and heavy construction layout
spans.onscreen_text: Achieves First Criticality Unit - 4 (700 MW, PHWR) @ 01:17 hrs December 17, 2023

spans.shows: Graphic map of India highlighting Gujarat state and Kakrapar location
spans.onscreen_text: Kakrapar Gujarat Site comprises of Units-1&2 (2 x 220 MW, PHWR)

spans.shows: Map animation indicating KAPP-3 and KAPP-4 operational status and national nuclear capacity statistics
spans.onscreen_text: KAPP-3 is operational KAPP-4 achieved First Criticality

spans.shows: Construction timelapse of the Kakrapar Unit 4 reactor building frame and containment structure
spans.onscreen_text: KAPP-3&4 Project 21000 MT structural steel used

spans.shows: Wide exterior shots of the nuclear containment dome and civil construction work with cranes
spans.onscreen_text: 1.4 million cubic meter concrete poured - 4 times used to build Burj Khalifa

spans.shows: Interior assembly and heavy engineering fabrication workshops for nuclear components
spans.onscreen_text: 1271 inch Km pipe erected ~ 2 times Mumbai - Ahmedabad distance
spans.fits: Indian engineers and workers at work (workshops)

spans.shows: Detailed views of heavy pipe fabrication and industrial manufacturing floors
spans.onscreen_text: 180 Km tubing laid.... 1.1 million inch dia pipe fabrication...
spans.fits: Indian engineers and workers at work (workshops)

spans.place_people: Shri Bhuwan Chandra Pathak, Chairman & Managing Director, NPCIL
spans.onscreen_text: Initial Fuel Loading... Shri Bhuwan Chandra Pathak Participated in Initial Fuel Loading of KAPP-4

spans.shows: Group of engineers and dignitaries observing fuel loading milestones and monitoring control screens
spans.place_people: Shri Bhuwan Chandra Pathak and NPCIL officials
spans.onscreen_text: a recent, successfully completed milestone... witnessed First Approach to Criticality

spans.shows: Wide group photo of project staff and leadership celebrating at the Kakrapar site
spans.onscreen_text: Gearing up further... Momentous occasion captured through the lens...

spans.onscreen_text: Poised for subsequent milestones... AND The Journey Continues...
